when compiling the lua lib the includeluaconf.h should be changed

add ".\\lua\\?.lua to the define #define LUA_PATH_DEFAULT

this was tried with version 2.0.6 beta it solve the strating problem

but a random crash after made maa drop the update

also this version try to load lua51.dll and we are using (atlas and mysql) lua5.1.dll


in luaconf.h we also defines (see below and adapt at least lua.h to these

but this done on the AAASeed side


#if defined(LUA_BUILD_AS_DLL)

	#if defined(LUA_CORE) || defined(LUA_LIB)

		#define LUA_API __declspec(dllexport)

	#else

		#define LUA_API __declspec(dllimport)

	#endif

#else

	#define LUA_API		extern __declspec(dllexport)

#endif


#ifndef MAACAPI

	#define	MAACAPI	__cdecl

#endif


#ifndef MAAAPIENTRY

	#define	MAAAPIENTRY	__cdecl

#endif

	/* more often than not the libs go together with the core */


#define LUALIB_API	LUA_API
